authorship: 30 explicit mission rows across six regions using12 hand-drawn cardinal lane geometries. Fixed pad priorities, budgets, health scales and every enemy group/timing are authored above; no RNG generates the campaign.

regions.name: Fernwake Glen
regions.subtitle: A lantern and a patient archer

regions.name: Willow Crossing
regions.subtitle: Watch both banks of the brook

missions.name: First Lantern
missions.hint: Tap a build pad, inspect range, then place an Archer before Next wave.

missions.name: The Elder's Lesson
missions.hint: Upgrade a tower between waves. Free Rally quickens every tower briefly.

missions.name: Mushroom Bend
missions.hint: Ember splashes catch close groups. Supplies from defeats fund later towers.

missions.name: Rootside Switch
missions.hint: Frost extends the time your damage towers can aim at runners.

missions.name: Two Garden Gates
missions.hint: Two fixed lanes share the keep. Choose coverage, not a blocked route.

missions.name: Stone Crossing
missions.hint: Prism is expensive but armor never reduces its damage.

missions.name: River Runners
missions.hint: Long corners reward slowing and overlapping range.

missions.name: Willow Fork
missions.hint: The shorter lane asks for a different pad than the longer lane.

missions.name: Low Tide Lanterns
missions.hint: Wisps ignore frost slow. Archer and prism still hit them.

missions.name: Bridgewatch
missions.hint: A Bramble costs three hearts if it reaches the keep.

missions.name: Orchard Rush
missions.hint: Splash is worth more when enemies arrive close together.

missions.name: Shellfall
missions.hint: Shellguards block sixty percent of arrows, not prism light.

missions.name: Golden Switch
missions.hint: A central prism can cover a bend without chasing both exits.

missions.name: Ember Road
missions.hint: Upgraded ember expands damage, not a secret paid advantage.

missions.name: Harvest Hold
missions.hint: Four waves leave time to plan between each assault.

missions.name: Frozen Wisp
missions.hint: Do not spend all your supplies on slow against immune wisps.

missions.name: Long Reach
missions.hint: Range previews make the distant turn a deliberate choice.

missions.name: Three Drifts
missions.hint: Mixed roles need mixed answers. Rally is always free.

missions.name: Thawline
missions.hint: Sell refunds seventy percent of spending, never more.

missions.name: The White Wall
missions.hint: Hold the white wall with both lanes in view.

missions.name: Twilight Thread
missions.hint: A short lane makes early coverage matter.

missions.name: Armored Root
missions.hint: Prism pays for armor piercing; archer still handles the stragglers.

missions.name: Split Echo
missions.hint: Read the route letters before calling each wave.

missions.name: Spore Cloud
missions.hint: Two embers can answer a crowd, but do not neglect the wisps.

missions.name: Rune Watch
missions.hint: The keep has no paid gate: retry and adjust your plan freely.

missions.name: The Last Orchard
missions.hint: Upgrade the pad with the best exposure, not merely the first pad.

missions.name: Glass Pass
missions.hint: Keep a fast tower behind the slow prism shots.

missions.name: Fourfold March
missions.hint: All four towers have a role. Every wave is shown before you commit.

missions.name: Iron Bloom
missions.hint: Free Rally can bridge a difficult overlap without an ad.

missions.name: Mosslight Dawn
missions.hint: One last long dawn. Earn the wall with a plan of your own.

missions.name: Copper Gate
